The vendor directly operating and providing **Matomo** at **matomo.org** is **InnoCraft Limited**.

### Provider Evidence
According to the official [Website Terms of Use](https://matomo.org/terms-of-use/) on `matomo.org`:
> *"Welcome to this Matomo® Analytics website (“Website”) operated by **InnoCraft Limited**, a New Zealand registered company founded by the creators of Matomo Analytics."*

Additionally, official documentation and service terms identify the provider:
> *"Matomo is provided by **InnoCraft Limited**, a New Zealand company..."*
